product.title: Cymbal Select Deep Frying Pan with Glass Lid, Navy, 28 cm

product.description:
A 7cm-deep design that handles stir-frying, simmering and shallow-frying in one pan. A durable 5-layer coating lasts long and it is dishwasher safe. The glass lid lets you check on food while it cooks.
